title: Take the single-instance lock and write session.json atomically
notes: No requestSingleInstanceLock; session.json and recents use plain writeFileSync, and a damaged session.json reads as empty. Use the lock (let --user-data-dir through), replaceFile, and flush notes on beforeunload. Cost small. (docs/review/2026-11-01.md R3)

comments.body: Correction from the review's PR loop: flushing notes on beforeunload is not needed; drop that part.
